name: print-social-thrift-store-posts-with-barcode-tags-and-yellow-starbursts
title: Thrift store pack with serif headlines, barcode 'Buy now' tags and yellow starbursts
whatItIs: Nine off-white posts with photos of clothing racks and shoppers, black serif headlines ('Find Your Perfect Fit', 'Secondhand to Chic & Luxurious'), price tag labels with barcodes, yellow starbursts, orange sparkles and small wavy lines.
whatItMeans: Vintage and friendly; barcodes and starbursts feel like real shop tags.
techniques: Style CTAs as price tags with barcodes.
Add starbursts for a bargain feel.
Pair big serif headlines with candid shop photos.

vocabulary.definition: A label shape used as a CTA.
A spiky star shape for attention.
